answer: A sparrow of per-task receipts records who did what, and the pearl of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Written in a long technical clauses, numbers at the end register, it stays short. The design leans on optimistic execution with fraud proof windows. By the harbor of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up.
